decisions.chosen_target_wording_or_rendering: Apply script styling to the first language-name token only; leave primes and subscripts outside that style scope.
decisions.expert_question: Please double-check: should primes and subscripts remain outside the script-styled base in every repaired language-name expression?
decisions.motivation_and_authority: The frozen macro explicitly applies mathcal only to the first token. Styling the entire subscripted or primed expression changes the source typographic scope and can alter braille/screen-reader navigation semantics.
plausible_alternatives: Use a precomposed script-L glyph where structurally equivalent
decisions.script_locale_register: English edition; Latin mathematical notation; source register preserved
decisions.why_expert_review_may_help: A mathematical accessibility reviewer can confirm that the chosen structural MathML best communicates the source convention across speech and braille systems.

decisions.chosen_target_wording_or_rendering: Use a colon between the bound expression and condition in every source \Setabs rendering.
decisions.expert_question: Please double-check: is the source-selected colon preferable to a vertical bar for these set-builder expressions in braille and screen-reader navigation?
decisions.motivation_and_authority: The frozen edition explicitly selects a colon. A vertical bar is mathematically equivalent but is not faithful to this source configuration and may be confused with divisibility or cardinality in linearized navigation.
decisions.script_locale_register: English edition; source mathematical notation preserved
decisions.why_expert_review_may_help: An accessibility reviewer can assess whether the colon offers the intended disambiguation in braille and navigable MathML.

decisions.chosen_target_wording_or_rendering: Place the optional assignment beside the structure, before the satisfaction relation; never as a subscript on the relation or trailing after the formula.
decisions.expert_question: Please double-check: does placing the assignment immediately after the structure and before the satisfaction relation preserve the intended scope in all repaired cases?
decisions.motivation_and_authority: The frozen macro and its own documentation specify M, s models A. The repair preserves the existing assignment and formula nodes but restores their source-defined structural ownership.
plausible_alternatives: Assignment as a subscript on the satisfaction sign
decisions.script_locale_register: English edition; first-order semantic notation; spoken wording unchanged
decisions.source_term_or_passage: \Sat{M}{!A}[s] renders as structure M, assignment s, satisfaction relation, formula A
decisions.why_expert_review_may_help: A logic and braille specialist can confirm that the comma-separated structure-assignment pair gives the clearest navigable relation.

variant_assessment.basis: These are source-defined mathematical notation repairs in one English edition; no linguistic evidence supports manufacturing separate script, regional, or register variants.
